The '''1983–84 Czechoslovak First League''' season of the top flight [[Czechoslovak First League]] annual [[Association football|football]] tournament in [[Czechoslovakia]] from 1925 to 1993.

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams. [[Sparta Prague]] prevailed as the [[#Results|1984 champions]]. [[Werner Lička]] was the league's top scorer with 20 goals.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=232}}</ref>
